brief:
Israel is using incendiary bombs, indiscriminate gunfire, and direct intimidation to force Palestinians from their homes in Gaza, Mondoweiss reported. The Israeli army has been progressively expanding what Palestinians call the "yellow line"—a security perimeter marking areas declared off-limits to civilians—deeper into the strip each day, depopulating entire neighborhoods in the process.

The displacement campaign relies on multiple methods of coercion to clear residential areas, according to the outlet. Those forced to leave are prevented from returning, effectively annexing territory within Gaza under Israeli military control.
dek: How the Israeli army is using incendiary bombs, indiscriminate gunfire, and direct intimidation to depopulate entire neighborhoods in Gaza.
title: Israeli forces displace Palestinians from Gaza neighborhoods daily
